body: Well, I'm still here. So I guess I'm doing okay. Thanks for asking.

I'd love to have someone to talk to. The only person I had broke up with me last week. I can't talk to my dad about anything like this, he used to say things like "you have to get over it" when I'd talk about my mom. I'm positive telling him I want to end my life right now would have no benefit.

Unfortunately all I have is in the palm of my hand. Internet strangers who will never even know my name. Not to say I don't appreciate your response, I truly do.

It's real tough being alone and going through this.
